description: This Dart source file defines the 'LocalGameController' class, which manages the state and interactions for a local game of Ludo within a Flutter application. It handles game mechanics such as starting new matches, rolling dice, applying moves, ending turns, restoring saved game state, and orchestrating AI behavior for non-human players. The class interacts with persistence layer, game rules engine, AI strategies, and uses Flutter-specific features like ChangeNotifier for state management.

classes.name: _AiComputeInput
classes.description: Immutable class used as input payload for AI move computation isolate. Contains game state, dice roll, legal moves, and AI difficulty.

methods.name: _selectMoveInIsolate
methods.description: Top-level function executed in an isolate to select an AI move based on provided game state, dice roll, legal moves, and difficulty. Ensures the selected move is legal.
